```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
# install.packages("fivethirtyeight")
library(fivethirtyeight)

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings

candy <- candy %>% 
  mutate(type = case_when(
    chocolate & fruity ~ "both",
    chocolate ~ "chocolate",
    fruity ~ "fruity",
    .default = "other"
  ))

# count(candy, type)
```

## Row 1 

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "warning",
  value = nrow(candy))

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Fruity Candies"

list(
  icon = "heart-fill",
  color = "secondary",
  value = sum(candy$type == "fruity"))

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Chocolate Candies"

list(
  icon = "heart-fill",
  color = "info",
  value = sum(candy$type == "chocolate"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Caramel Candies"

list(
  icon = "heart-fill",
  color = "success",
  value = sum(candy$type == "caramel"))
```

## Row 2 

```{r}
#| label: sugar-rush
#| fig-cap: "Does more sugar mean more popular?"

candysugarpercent <- candy %>% 
  mutate(sugar_category = case_when(
    sugarpercent <= 0.2 & sugarpercent >= 0 ~ "0.0-0.2% sugar",
    sugarpercent <= 0.4 & sugarpercent >= 0.2 ~ "0.2-0.4% sugar",
    sugarpercent <= 0.6 & sugarpercent >= 0.4 ~ "0.4-0.6% sugar",
    sugarpercent <= 0.8 & sugarpercent >= 0.6 ~ "0.6-0.8% sugar",
    sugarpercent <= 1.0 & sugarpercent >= 0.8 ~ "0.8-1.0% sugar",
  ))

# count(candy, sugarpercent)


candywinpercent <- candy %>% 
  mutate(sugar_wins = case_when(
    winpercent <= 25 & winpercent >= 0 ~ "0-25% win rate",
    winpercent <= 50 & winpercent >= 25 ~ "25-50% win rate",
    winpercent <= 75 & winpercent >= 50 ~ "30-75% win rate",
    winpercent <= 100 & winpercent >= 75 ~ "75-100% win rate",
  ))



# count(candy, winpercent)

candywinsugar <- ggplot(data = candysugarpercent, 
       aes(x = sugar_category, y = winpercent, label = competitorname)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#E83E8C") + 
  geom_point(color = "#6F42C1") + 
  labs(
    title = "Sugar Rush!",
    x = "Sugar Percentage",
    y = "Win Percentage"
  ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        family = "Comic Sans MS",
        face = "bold",
        size = 20,
        hjust = 0.5
      )
    )


ggplotly(candywinsugar)
```
